Popular content creators Habeeb Adelaja, popularly known as Peller, and his wife Elizabeth Amaduo, also known as Jarvis, have officially revealed that they are expecting a baby boy. The couple shared the exciting news on Sunday through a gender reveal video posted on their Instagram page. In the video, the pair appear at an elegant outdoor setup featuring a white-themed stage, large “BABY” letter decorations, balloons, and soft lighting amid greenery. Dressed in matching white outfits, a visibly pregnant Jarvis and Peller stand together on the platform. They trigger the reveal, releasing a burst of blue smoke and blue confetti that fills the air as guests cheer and celebrate around them. In gender reveal traditions, blue signifies a baby boy, while pink typically indicates a baby girl. The blue smoke and confetti in the video confirmed the couple is expecting a son. Accompanying the video, Peller and Jarvis praised God and wrote a heartfelt letter to their expecting child. Make PUNCH part of your everyday experience. God has blessed us with a precious gift, and we can’t wait to hold you in our arms, kiss your little face and show you how much you are loved. “My child, you may not know it yet, but you are already the reason behind so many smiles, tears of joy and endless prayers. Daddy and Mummy can’t wait to begin this beautiful journey with you. “Our little blessing, our answered prayer, our greatest joy. We love you already. Indian creator beats Peller, Carter Efe to streamer award Jarvis, Peller, Sina Rambo’s marriages hit fresh crises Couples redefining Nigeria’s content space “Thank You, Lord, for this precious gift.” Peller and Jarvis first connected through TikTok livestreams in 2023 and their relationship grew publicly over the years. After an earlier proposal in late 2024, Peller formally proposed again in June 2026 during a beachfront ceremony in Ghana. He later completed traditional marriage rites, including paying the bride price, in Jarvis’s hometown of Benin City that same month. The couple held their civil wedding in Lagos on 29 July 2026, followed by their white wedding celebrations in early August 2026. The gender reveal comes weeks after the couple publicly announced their pregnancy in early October 2026.
